Orc Raid on Thais









































Browse Map (32333, 32298, 7)

Because of their previous defeats from the army of Thais, the Orcs invade Thais from all directions - each entrance to the city is blocked by massive armies of orcs.

There are three raids, only two have announcements. The first occurs when orc activity is announced, some weak orcs (probably spies/reporters) spawn at the city entrances. A few minutes later, a more serious army is sent, until finally, a few minutes later, the leaders come with the final troops. It is only during the last wave that warlords spawn.

Subarea: Thais Surroundings

Events:

  1. 00:00: Orc activity near Thais reported! Beware!
  2. 00:04: (unannounced raid)
  3. 00:07: Thais is under attack!
  4. 00:09: (unannounced raid)

Unannounced Raids

Insectoid Scout on Greenshore Farms

Insectoid Scouts sometimes spawn in the Greenshore Farms, west of the town. If not enough Insectoid Scouts are killed until server save, the Insectoid Invasion World Change will start the next day (and will persist as long as not enough Insectoid Scouts are killed).

Events:

  1. 00:00: (unannounced raid)

Orc Attack on Thais Lighthouse

Sometimes you might meet Orcs inside and around the lighthouse southeast of Thais. On the ground, there are some plain vanilla Orcs and one Orc Berserker. When travelling higher in the tower you will meet their stronger fellows.

Historic Raids

Historic: Primitive Raid

This raid happened in the tibia 10th anniversary. It may happen again during other events. The three monsters faced in the raid represent problems faced by Tibia in the past. Primitives represent obnoxious players, Hackers represent people who try and hack the game, and Tibia Bugs represent hostile programs created by these hackers.

Events:

  1. 00:00: Primitives are attacking Thais!
  2. 00:??: Primitives are everywhere in Thais trying a take over!
  3. 00:??: Stop the primitives in Thais!

Note: The monsters will still keep spawning even after the warnings stop.
